assignment: Prove preservation of full-interface return guards across successive actual decimal reverse-add steps, or produce and formalize an exact counterexample if the proposed preservation is false.
target_statement: For an admissible canonical actual pair-word orbit satisfying the existing seven-step/full-interface return guard at one return, determine whether the same return guard is preserved at the returned interface after the seven actual reverse-add steps; accepted outcome must be a proved preservation theorem or a formally checkable counterexample to the precise proposed invariant.
remaining_obligation: Kernel-check the concrete ordinary-decimal counterexample and independently review semantics; if the proposed invariant is false, replace the preservation target with the exact counterexample disposition rather than weakening hypotheses silently.
